rootDependency.statement: The process begins inside an already-existing coupling and relationship state. It does not create the substrate by talking about it.

purpose: Turn an ambiguous signal, recurring pattern, conflict, or high-stakes question into a human-ratified orientation, a bounded authorized move, and a proof-bearing update without erasing dissent, provenance, or authorship.

externalLineage.name: Dialectic into Dialogos
externalLineage.notClaimed: YAWN does not claim its software protocol is identical to the authors' full philosophical practice.

distinctions.dialectic: Differentiate claims, reveal assumptions, generate counterexamples, and expose contradictions or category errors.
distinctions.dialogos: Enter a participatory phase in which distinct agents hold positions provisionally, establish shared reference, and allow the interaction to transform their orientations without requiring consensus.
distinctions.deliberation: Compare the resulting possibilities under values, constraints, risks, and decision rights.
distinctions.ratification: A rightful human or collective adopts, rejects, defers, or reframes a proposed direction.
distinctions.execution: A capability-bound agent attempts one authorized move.
distinctions.proof: Independent or appropriately separated evidence evaluates the consequence and constrains the update.

fast.rule: Do not force a ceremonial Dialogos session when a small reversible action and clear proof can safely answer the question.

useWhenAny: ontology, policy, autonomy, identity, or public-purpose change
the user explicitly asks for pressure testing or deeper collective orientation

stages.purpose: Name the participants, arena, coupling, relationship history, stakes, boundaries, access, authority, and affected parties before interpreting the signal.
Preserve the exact source, provenance, timestamps, transformations, and uncertainty before synthesis.
Let each relevant participant or represented position state what they observe, infer, value, fear, protect, and want without yet forcing synthesis.
Steelman and pressure-test the articulated positions through counterexamples, falsifiers, scope checks, and category-boundary checks.
Collect observations through meaningfully different actors, stances, access channels, methods, and source lineages while discounting correlated passes.
Hold positions in suspension long enough to establish shared reference, notice interaction effects, and permit mutual transformation without erasing the poles or demanding consensus.
Separate what is robust across applicable apertures from complementary facets, live conflicts, blind spots, and aperture-specific residue.
Materialize a reviewable current orientation: present state, possible state, lacuna, competing directions, risks, values, authority, and candidate next moves.
The rightful human or collective adopts, rejects, defers, narrows, or reframes the proposed direction. Ratification changes what is operative, not what is empirically true.
Bind the selected move to exact scope, capability, cost, privacy, timing, rollback, and proof conditions.
Attempt the smallest safe move that reduces the highest-priority lacuna, produces useful proof, and preserves meaningful options.
Observe what reality and affected agents return; evaluate the declared proof condition independently enough that the move cannot prove itself.
Append authorized events, rematerialize state, preserve superseded orientations, and begin the next turn from the changed relationship.
Repeated clean proof may justify a proposal to widen autonomy, trust, scope, or responsibility. Graduation never activates itself.

roles.responsibility: Preserve exact source, provenance, transformations, and privacy.
Construct the strongest coherent version of a position.
Seek counterexamples, boundary failures, and unsafe assumptions.
Contribute a genuinely different actor, stance, access channel, method, or source lineage.
Compile nexus, residue, conflicts, blind spots, and proposed orientation without pretending to own the decision.
Ratify direction and retain terminal-goal, meaning, consent, and consequential decision rights.
Attempt only the exact authorized move.
Evaluate consequence against the declared condition with visible independence and limitations.

passContract.independenceRule: Multiple passes by the same actor or model over the same sources are correlated unless a materially different access channel or method is demonstrated. Repetition is not independent confirmation.

invariants: Coupling and relationship remain the substrate; dialogical orientation is an internal process.
Distinct agents and arenas are never collapsed into one synthetic actor.
Shared reference does not require shared interpretation.
Dialogos does not mean consensus, voting, persuasion, or emotional harmony.
Dialectic exposes differences; it does not automatically decide among values.
A model may propose a synthesis but may not ratify the human terminal direction.
Epistemic confidence and governance adoption remain separate.
The same model repeating itself does not create aperture diversity.
Residue, dissent, conflicts, and blind spots remain first-class outputs.
No move may occur before ratification and authorization when consequential effects are involved.
Graduation follows repeated proof and remains proposal-only until rightful activation.
Routine reversible work may use the fast mode; full dialogical processing is not a universal ritual.
stopConditions: The question is adequately oriented and a bounded proof-producing move is ratified.
No safe or authorized move exists; the turn enters an explicit waiting state.
The relationship boundary or consent required for continued inquiry is absent.
New evidence is required before further dialogue can improve orientation.
The session is generating repetition without new aperture, evidence, or discriminating test.
successMeasures: time to identify the active lacuna
number and quality of genuinely distinct apertures
time to one bounded next move
whether users understand who owns the decision
stableShorthand: Dialogos transforms orientation without erasing difference.
The nexus guides; the rightful steward decides.
